title: Gummi World Renews Its Commitment to Excellence with NSF 455-2 cGMP Recertification | User | malvern-online.com
text:
Gummi World maintains one of the strongest compliance portfolios in the industry with renewed NSF/ANSI 455-2 certification.
(PRUnderground) July 2nd, 2025
Gummi World, a subsidiary of Intiva Group, has once again earned NSF/ANSI 455-2 certification for Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) in Dietary Supplements, reaffirming its dedication to quality, safety, and compliance at every level of production.
The recertification follows a thorough third-party audit of Gummi World’s facility in Chandler, Arizona, confirming the company continues to meet (and in many cases exceed) the strict standards set by the FDA’s 21 CFR 111 for dietary supplement manufacturing.
“Reaching this level of operational discipline year after year speaks volumes about our team’s culture and our clients’ trust in us,” said Alexander C. Candelario, Chairman and CEO of Intiva Group, parent company of Gummi World. “It’s a direct result of our team’s discipline and a clear signal to our partners that we’re serious about long-term quality, transparency, and growth.”
What NSF 455-2 Certification Means
The NSF/ANSI 455-2 standard evaluates dietary supplement manufacturers across a broad range of critical areas, including:
Personnel training and qualifications
Sanitation and environmental controls Ingredient and finished product testing
Equipment validation and maintenance Documentation, packaging, and labeling procedures In short, it confirms that every stage of the manufacturing process, from sourcing raw materials to final packaging, follows rigorous safety and regulatory guidelines.
For clients, this certification provides added assurance that:
Products are made in a facility subject to independent, unannounced audits Supply chain risks are minimized through strong traceability and testing practices Products are retail-ready and meet compliance standards across various sales channels “In a market where more consumers are reading labels, researching ingredients, and demanding proof, this cGMP recertification gives our partners a real competitive edge,” said Dr. Ayan Monpara, MD, Chief Medical Officer of Intiva Group.
Meeting the Needs of Today’s Supplement Brands
Gummi World’s NSF 455-2 recertification comes as the company continues to grow its capabilities and lead innovation in the supplement space. Beyond this latest achievement, Gummi World maintains a comprehensive set of certifications and industry distinctions, including:
NSF Health Sciences Certified Product Certification (HSCPC) NSF Certified for Sport® OTC product manufacturing certification (gummy format) Costco Product Certification SGS cGMP and Non-GMO Project Verified Kosher, Halal, USDA Organic, and more This strong compliance foundation allows Gummi World to serve a wide range of partners, from fast-moving wellness startups to global brands that require large-scale, retail-ready production.
Whether it’s vitamin gummies, custom capsule blends, or OTC-compliant formulas, Gummi World manages the entire process, from formulation and testing to packaging and fulfillment, all under one fully audited roof.
Scaling Smarter with Trusted Certifications
As scrutiny across the supplement industry intensifies, from both regulators and increasingly informed consumers, certifications like NSF 455-2 have become essential for any brand aiming to grow responsibly and sustainably.
Gummi World’s continued certification signals:
A culture of operational discipline, validated through independent audits Scalable, low-risk production processes built to meet evolving market demands A long-term manufacturing approach focused on quality, consistency, and compliance “Certifications aren’t just plaques on the wall—they’re the operational backbone of every successful health product on the shelf,” said Alexander C. Candelario. “Our goal has always been to create a facility where compliance is second nature, and that commitment shows up in every batch we produce.”
To learn more about Gummi World’s capabilities, certifications, and to request a quote, visit gummiworld.com today.
About Gummi World
Intiva Health is revolutionizing the health of healthcare through technology, compliance, and wellness innovation. As the parent company of Incredable, Gummi World, and Nova Vita Wellness Centers, Intiva Health delivers cutting-edge solutions across multiple sectors. Incredable streamlines provider credentialing and compliance with an industry-leading digital platform. Gummi World, the most certified nutraceutical manufacturer in the industry, ensures unmatched quality and safety in custom gummy and supplement production. Nova Vita Wellness Centers provide advanced regenerative health therapies, including IV infusions, peptides, and telehealth services. Together, these companies are transforming healthcare by improving efficiency, accessibility, and patient outcomes.
